messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate spiked to 4.8%. Batching queue backlog rising rapidly. Auto-paging to #incidents. Severity: P1.

oncall-amanda: ack, I'm oncall. Seeing timeouts starting ~2m ago. Traces show tail latencies through scheduler -> batcher. Will grab logs and start triage.

priya-sre: digging in. Kibana: https://kibana.internal/app/discover#/query?service=runtime&env=us-west-2 . Lots of 502 from gateway and 504s from runtime. Batcher queue length: 1800 -> 3200 in last 5m. Head-of-line blocking appears concentrated on batcher shard 12.

alex-engineering: fyi: we pushed a batching policy tweak in last deploy (increase max_batch_size, lowered batch_timeout). Could affect small/interactive requests and cause starvation. Also a kvcache prefetch change went out in same window.

oncall-amanda: rolling back batching policy now for canary. Command: `rdctl config apply --name=batcher_policy --version=2026-03-15-rollback` — running, ETA ~30s.

infra-bot: Deploy started: batcher_policy rollback job id bkp-4623. CI link: https://ci.internal/jobs/bkp-4623

deploy-bot: Canary rollback applied to 10% of batcher pods in us-west-2 at 4623456685.

ops-eli: customer-impact: CS reports several customers seeing 5xx in product UIs. Not widespread degraded UX, but two enterprise customers hitting errors intermittently. Notified AE.

product-support: confirmed ~5 affected customers in last 10m, escalating to account teams. Providing interim status note.

oncall-amanda: rollback applied to canary, metrics look slightly better but still elevated errors on shard 12. Continuing investigation.

priya-sre: found repeated sync kvcache prefetches in shard 12 logs causing CPU stalls and blocking batch dispatch. Snippet: ```
kvcache: fetch_sync key=usr:kv:... pid=3421 wait=120ms
scheduler: batch_hold=true
```
Looks correlated with request bursts that are small and latency-sensitive.

alex-engineering: that kv-prefetch sync behavior was introduced in the same deploy. Suggest disabling kvcache prefetch on the affected shard to remove head-of-line blocking while we roll forward a proper async prefetch fix. Command prepared: `rdctl runtime set --kv-prefetch=false --scope=shard:12`. Need oncall approval.

oncall-amanda: approved, apply the flag.

infra-bot: Runtime flag change applied to shard 12 at 4623456742: `kv-prefetch=false`.

ops-eli: immediate effect visible — queue length dropped from ~3200 -> ~1500 within ~40s. Gateway 5xx rate down from 4.8% -> 1.2%.

product-support: notifying affected customers: "we have active mitigations (policy rollback + runtime flag change). We'll provide next update in 15m."

priya-sre: still seeing residual 504s from overloaded batcher workers at high tail. Proposal: enable a temporary routing circuit-breaker that routes requests with queued_time > 200ms to a smaller fallback model to drain the backlog and protect user-facing requests.

alex-engineering: patch ready for routing fallback:
```
routes:
  - match: queued_ms > 200
    route: large-v2-fallback
```
Can toggle via `rdctl routing enable rule queued-fallback-usw2`.

oncall-amanda: enable queued-fallback-usw2 now.

infra-bot: Routing rule queued-fallback-usw2 enabled at 4623456780.

ops-eli: tail latencies improved immediately. 5xx down to 0.4%. Queue dropping to ~600.

product-support: updating customers: errors reduced and mitigations active. Preparing follow-up and requesting postmortem.

priya-sre: capturing timeline for postmortem: deploys, batching policy change, kv-prefetch flag timeline, rollback times, routing rule enable time, queue depth metrics. Will create incident doc in next 30m.

oncall-amanda: handoff notes for next oncall:
- Incident: P1 elevated 5xx/timeouts in us-west-2 caused by batcher starvation / head-of-line blocking.
- Root factors: batching policy change + synchronous kvcache prefetch causing batcher CPU stalls on shard 12.
- Mitigations applied: rollback canary of batching policy, disabled kv-prefetch on shard 12, enabled queued-time fallback routing to smaller model.
- Current state: KPIs improving (5xx ~0.4%, queue ~600).
- Next steps: verify full rollback, revert/clean deploy of kv-prefetch async implementation, monitor for recurrence, notify affected customers via AE.

oncall-amanda: handing off to priya for overlap at 4623456815.

priya-sre: ack — I'll take overnight watch, finish the incident doc and postmortem notes, and follow up with alex on async prefetch ticket. Thanks team :thumbsup:
